title: Hakuna Matata Vacation Rental
meta_description: Hakuna Matata is a 4.00 bedroom, 3.50 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: DescriptionHakuna MatataProminence • Watersound, FL 32461Home Highlights4 bedrooms3.5 bathroomsSleeps 10 guestsIn-home Elevator3,400+ sq. ft.2 community pools with bathrooms (heated seasonally; dates set by the community)4 Free Adult Bikes Included (Not available Dec–Feb; additional rentals available upon request)Walk to The Big ChillResort-style grilling areasParking for 4 vehicles - 2 in the garage and 2 in the driveway (no street parking permitted)Welcome to Hakuna MatataHakuna Matata is a spacious 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath vacation home on 30A, ideally located on the south side of Prominence and directly across from the resort-style pool. Designed for comfort and convenience, this home sleeps up to 10 guests and is perfect for families and groups looking for a premium 30A beach rental.The home features two private bedroom suites, generous sleeping arrangements, and large open living spaces ideal for entertaining. The open-concept kitchen, dining, and living area creates a welcoming space to gather after a day at the beach or pool. An in-home elevator provides easy access to all levels, making this property especially appealing for multi-generational stays. Multiple indoor and outdoor living areas offer room to relax, unwind, and enjoy the laid-back coastal lifestyle that defines 30A.Guests will love the unbeatable pool location, just steps from the front door, as well as easy access to Prominence amenities, beach access, bike paths, dining, and shopping along Scenic Highway 30A. Whether you’re planning a family vacation, a friends’ getaway, or an extended stay, Hakuna Matata delivers the space, location, and comfort in one of Prominence's most sought-after locations.About Prominence on 30A – Watersound, FloridaSet along the iconic 30A corridor, Prominence is a highly sought-after community known for its exceptional amenities, well-maintained green spaces, and access to over 17 miles of scenic bike paths. Its ideal central location puts you close to beloved beach towns—Seagrove and Seaside to the west, Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach to the east—and just moments from pristine white-sand beaches.At the center of the community is The Big Chill, a vibrant gathering place featuring a massive 25-foot LED theater screen for sporting events and movies, live music, kids’ activities, dining, and boutique shopping—all just a short walk from your door. With endless entertainment, natural beauty, and upscale amenities, Prominence is the perfect setting for a family friendly coastal escape.Reservation & Booking PoliciesPlease Note: The cancelation policy and terms of the 30A Cottages & Concierge Vacation Rental Agreement emailed at confirmation supersede any policies listed by third-party booking sites (VRBO, Airbnb, HomeAway, etc.). We cannot reimburse third-party service fees. We do not offer a 100% refund once a booking has been processed. All cancelations incur a 5% fee to cover processing costs.Payment50% of total cost is due at bookingFinal balance is due 60 days prior to arrivalIf booking within 60 days of arrival, full payment is requiredCancelationsExcept for a 5% processing fee, the initial 50% payment is fully refundable if cancelation is made more than 60 days before arrivalTravel InsuranceOptional travel insurance is availableMust be purchased before final payment or at the time the reservation is paid in fullCheck-In / Check-OutCheck-in: 4:00 PM CSTCheck-out: 10:00 AM CSTParkingParking for 4 vehicles- Garage for 2 vehicles and Driveway parking for 2 vehicles, depending on sizeNo street parking allowedRulesNO SMOKINGNOT Pet-Friendly Tenant must be 25+ years of age and must occupy the home for the entire stayPublished rates do not include taxes and fees
